evidence.quote: This release adds `require()` support for synchronous ESM graphs under the flag `--experimental-require-module`.

units.rationale: Correctly identifies the launch-time opt-in flag and contrasts launch with later default enabling; the official launch announcement explicitly supplies the flag.

evidence.quote: In this release, it is now no longer behind a flag on v22.x.

evidence.quote: This feature is still experimental, and we are looking for user feedback to make more final tweaks before fully stabilizing it.

evidence.quote: It can, however, throw ERR_REQUIRE_ASYNC_MODULE if the ES module being loaded or its dependencies contain top-level await.

units.rationale: Gives the precise error and correctly includes top-level await in dependencies, with the source's qualified can-throw formulation.

evidence.quote: this feature can also be disabled using --no-experimental-require-module as a workaround.
